title: Apple - Think Different
script: Here's to the crazy ones. The misfits. The rebels. The troublemakers. The round pegs in the square holes...
principle: Emotional storytelling, celebrating the user, minimal product focus

title: Nike - Just Do It
script: If you have a body, you are an athlete. Just Do It.
principle: Empowerment, universal appeal, strong call to action

title: Old Spice - The Man Your Man Could Smell Like
script: Hello, ladies. Look at your man, now back to me...
principle: Humor, surprise, breaking the fourth wall, memorable character

title: Dove - Real Beauty Sketches
script: You are more beautiful than you think.
principle: Emotional, social impact, real people, authenticity

title: Dos Equis - The Most Interesting Man in the World
script: I don't always drink beer, but when I do, I prefer Dos Equis.

title: Fun Topic: Bigfoot Sighting
script: Imagine your product is so good, even Bigfoot comes out of hiding to get it!

title: Fun Topic: Alien Encounter
script: Aliens land on Earth, but they're only interested in your product.

title: Fun Topic: Time Travel
script: A time traveler from the future comes back just to use your product.

title: Fun Topic: Parallel Universe
script: In every universe, your product is a hit—even with superheroes and villains.

title: Fun Topic: Talking Animals
script: A wisecracking animal becomes the spokesperson for your brand.

title: Creative Principle: The Unexpected Twist
script: Start with a familiar scene, then surprise the viewer with an unexpected turn.

title: Creative Principle: Visual Metaphor
script: Use a strong visual metaphor to represent the product's benefit (e.g., a rocket for speed, a shield for protection).

title: Tip: Make it Fun
script: Inject humor, playfulness, or a sense of adventure to make your ad memorable.

title: Tip: Use Pop Culture References
script: Reference trending topics, memes, or cultural moments to make your ad feel current.

title: Do: Focus on Transformation
script: Show how the product changes the user's life for the better.

title: Don't: Overwhelm with Information
script: Keep the message simple and focused. One big idea per ad.

title: Fun Topic: The Future
script: Imagine a world where your product shapes the future.

title: Fun Topic: Everyday Heroes
script: Celebrate ordinary people doing extraordinary things with your product.

title: Volkswagen - Think Small
script: Think small.

title: Coca-Cola - Share a Coke
script: Share a Coke with...

title: Guinness - Surfer
script: He waits. The waves crash. The white horses charge. Victory comes to those who wait.
principle: Epic storytelling, patience, visual metaphor, cinematic

title: Cadbury - Gorilla
script: A gorilla drums to Phil Collins' 'In the Air Tonight.' Unexpected, joyful, unforgettable.

title: John Lewis - Christmas Ad
script: A little boy impatiently waits for Christmas—not to receive, but to give.

title: Budweiser - Whassup?
script: "Whassup?!" Friends greet each other in a way that becomes a cultural catchphrase.

title: Creative Principle: The Power of Emotion
script: Make the audience laugh, cry, or feel inspired. Emotion drives sharing and memory.

title: Creative Principle: Simplicity Wins
script: Focus on one big idea. Remove anything that doesn't support it.

title: Tip: Use a Relatable Hero
script: Feature an everyday person overcoming a challenge with your product.

title: Tip: Leverage Pop Culture
script: Reference movies, memes, or trending topics to feel current and shareable.

title: Research Insight: Story Structure
script: Great ads often follow a story arc: setup, conflict, resolution.

title: Research Insight: Visual Metaphor
script: Use strong visuals to symbolize your product's benefit (e.g., a rocket for speed).

title: Research Insight: Social Proof
script: Show real people or testimonials to build trust.

title: Research Insight: Humor Works
script: Funny ads are more likely to be remembered and shared.

title: Research Insight: Music & Sound
script: A catchy song or sound effect can make your ad unforgettable.

title: Liquid Death - Murder Your Thirst
script: A can of water is treated like a rockstar at a wild concert. Fans cheer, security guards protect it, and the can crowd-surfs. Suddenly, the can cracks open, water splashes everywhere, and the crowd goes wild. The ad ends with a close-up of the can: 'Murder Your Thirst.'
principle: Shock value, humor, and subverting expectations. Uses pop culture and meme energy to make water exciting.
